_comment: 界面语言包 · English。键是简体中文原文，值是译文。缺条目时界面回落中文原文——这是设计，不是遗漏：一份翻译没写完不该让人看到空白。插值用 {name} 命名占位符。
不随系统，固定使用此模式: Fixed to this mode, ignores system
仅影响会话内容的字号: Only affects text in the conversation
登录系统后自动打开空谷: Open Ondra automatically after you sign in
有任务在跑时保持系统唤醒: Keep the system awake while a task is running
任务完成、插件报错时提醒: Notify when a task finishes or a plugin fails
应用内打开的网页只能来自这份清单；当前 {n} 个站点: In-app pages can only come from this list; {n} sites now
智能体运行时 Enter 键和发送按钮的行为；⌘ Enter 使用另一行为: What Enter and the send button do while the agent runs; ⌘ Enter uses the other one
关掉后用 ⌘ Enter 发送，回车换行: When off, ⌘ Enter sends and Enter makes a new line
关掉后新对话不再写入记忆点: New conversations no longer write memory entries
回答前先翻一遍相关的记忆点: Look through relevant memory before answering
把反复出现的做法沉成偏好，不必每次重说: Turn recurring habits into preferences so you need not repeat them
多久没被引用的记忆会沉底；只忘不删，仍可被翻到: How long an unreferenced memory stays afloat; faded, never deleted
把回答念出来，长回答只念前两段: Speak the answer; long answers read the first two paragraphs only
本地识别失败时把录音发到云端；关掉即纯本机: Send audio to the cloud when local recognition fails; off means local only
图片发往云端无需确认: Send images to cloud without asking
没有隐私插件时仍允许把图发出去；默认关闭，出站要先问: Allow images to leave without the privacy plugin; off by default, outbound asks first
插件需要时才能截取当前窗口: Plugins may capture the current window when needed
写日志前去掉路径、邮箱、密钥等敏感片段: Strip paths, emails and keys before writing logs
密钥只进系统钥匙串，不写进任何配置文件: Keys go only into the system keychain, never into config files
nightly 更新更快，stable 更稳: nightly ships faster, stable is steadier
本项只影响界面：内核还没有对应的配置段: Display only: the kernel has no matching config section yet
本项需要通道插件：未安装时只记录界面选择: Needs the channel plugin: without it only the choice is recorded
每晚检查旧记忆，该沉底的沉底、该归档的归档: Nightly check: settle or archive old memories
